MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Financing Authority,
  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency,
  Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  December 10, 2019

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Raths at 5:02 p.m. on December 10, 2019, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on December 6, 2019, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and Norman P.
Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Bucknum
  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Sachs
  Mayor Pro Tem Goodell
  Mayor Raths

Absent:  None

Staff Present: Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

CLOSED SESSION

CS1. Conference with Legal Counsel: Existing Litigation Pursuant to Paragraph 4 of
  Subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 - Southwest Voter Registration Education Project
  v. The City of Mission Viejo.

RECESS AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:03 p.m. Mayor Raths recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City Council
reconvened in the Council Chamber at 6:03 p.m. with all five Council Members present.

City Council Minutes  1  December 10, 2019
 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that the Council addressed one Closed Session item to review
an existing litigation matter. Council gave direction but there were no reportable actions taken.

INVOCATION: Council Member Kelley

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Bucknum

PRESENTATIONS

P1. State of the City

  Received Mayor Raths’ State of the City presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Bill Moorhead, M.V.: Announced that he is a new Board Member for Lake Mission Viejo
Association as well as a member of the Moulton Niguel Water District Board of Directors.

Monica Robles, Dana Point: Introduced her company, the Heart Centered Leadership Coaching &
Consulting Group, which has a mission to educate, motivate and empower the Hispanic
community.

Michael Rochter, M.V.: Announced that the City of Irvine recently adopted Community Choice
Energy and stated that he hopes the Mission Viejo Council will consider the program. Mr. Rochter
spoke about various sustainability methods during the holidays.

Briana Walker, M.V.: Expressed her fears and concerns about activities in her neighborhood. She
asked that the City help to rectify the situation.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Goodell, seconded by Council Member Sachs, to approve the
Consent Calendar as outlined below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of November 12, 2019, as
  presented.

2.  Check Register Dated November 1, 2019 in the Amount of $2,607,926.00

City Council Minutes  2  December 10, 2019
   Ratified the accompanying check register.

3.  Check Register Dated November 8, 2019 in the Amount of $1,174,046.46

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

4.  Check Register Dated November 15, 2019 in the Amount of $603,544.51

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

5.  Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo for the Fiscal
  Year Ended June 30, 2019 and Related Reports

  Received and filed.

6.  Fiscal Year 2018/19 Mission Viejo Housing Authority Annual Report

  Received and filed.

7.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo – First Quarter 2019/20

  Received and filed.

8.  Annual Measure M2 Expenditure Report for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019

  Approved Resolution 19-45 Adopting the Measure M2 Expenditure Report for the City of
  Mission Viejo.

9.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for October 2019

  Received and filed.

10. Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer’s
  Monthly Report for October 2019

  Received and filed.

11. Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer’s Monthly Report
  for October 2019

  Received and filed.

12. Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for October
  2019

  Received and filed.

13. Craycraft Park Restroom Building - (CIP 315)

City Council Minutes  3  December 10, 2019
   Approved the plans and specifications and authorized staff to advertise for bids for the
  Craycraft Park Restroom Building - (CIP 315).

14. Annual Park and Facility Hardscape Construction Improvement Contract - S. Parker
  Engineering, Inc.

  (1) Approved Sixth Amendment to the existing maintenance contract with S. Parker
  Engineering, Inc for the subject services; and (2) authorized a Change Order to the existing
  Purchase Order for S. Parker Engineering, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $200,000.00.

15. Comprehensive Organization Review for the Animal Services Division

  Approved the agreement with Management Partners, Inc., in an amount not to exceed
  $39,900 for organization review consulting services.

16. 2020 Orange County International Triathlon in Mission Viejo

  Approved the request submitted by Gemini Timing to hold the 2020 Orange County
  International Triathlon in Mission Viejo on Sunday, June 7, 2020.

ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

OLD BUSINESS

17. Solid Waste Services Agreement

  Environmental Programs Administrator Denise Matson presented the staff report.

  Joe Sloan of Sloan Vasquez McAfee displayed a PowerPoint presentation and answered
  questions from the Council.

  Chrystal Denning, CR&R, Inc.: Thanked the City Council for the opportunity to be a part of
  this process and for their time.

  Chip Monaco, Waste Management: Stated that it is an honor and privilege to serve the City,
  the residents, businesses and most importantly the non-profit community within the City. He
  thanked the sub-committee members, City Staff and the Consultants.

  Motion made by Council Member Bucknum, seconded by Council Member Kelley, to direct
  staff and the Integrated Solid Waste Ad Hoc Committee to negotiate a final agreement with
  Waste Management that includes street sweeping services and an adjustment of solid waste
  collector fees to the County average and return to Council for award of contract in January
  2020.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
City Council Minutes  4  December 10, 2019
 18.  City Sidewalk Speed Limit

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services Keith Ratty presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Kelley, seconded by Council Member Bucknum to
  introduce Ordinance 19-334 Amending Mission Viejo Municipal Code of Ordinances
  Section 12.15.100 to Increase the Bicycle Speed on Sidewalks From 5 Miles Per Hour to 12
  Miles Per Hour.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, and Raths,
  NOES:  Sachs
  ABSENT:  None

NEW BUSINESS

19. Appeal of Special Sign Permit SSP2019-174 - Petition submitted by Jack Werner, with
  SignWorld Business Partners Inc., to Permit an Oversized Monument Sign and a
  Second Monument Sign for Mount of Olives Lutheran Church, Located at 24772
  Chrisanta Drive, in the CF (Community Facilities) Zone

  Director of Community Development Elaine Lister gave the staff report.

  Pastor Stewart presented information on the Mount of Olives Lutheran Church special sign
  permit project and the conditions that they seek to modify

  The following spoke in favor of the appeal petition of the Special Sign Permit: Glenn
  Jerpseth, M.V.; David Hindley, M.V.; and Mike Rey, M.V.

  Motion made by Council Member Bucknum, seconded by Council Member Kelley, to adopt
  Resolution 19-46 Approving the Appeal Petition and Modifying the Planning and
  Transportation Commission’s Approval of Special Sign Permit SSP2019-174, a Petition
  Submitted by Jack Werner to Permit an Oversized Monument Sign and a Second Monument
  Sign for Mount of Olives Church, Located at 24772 Chrisanta Drive, in the CF (Community
  Facilities) Zone, with a Stucco Sign Base Rather than the Stone Base approved by the
  Planning and Transportation Commission.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

20. Amending the City of Mission Viejo Salary Schedule and Authorized Position Schedule

  Human Resources Manager Monique Goetz presented the staff report.

City Council Minutes  5  December 10, 2019
   Motion made by Council Member Kelley, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Goodell, to adopt
  Resolution 19-47 Amending the City’s Salary Schedule and Authorized Position Schedule
  Effective January 1, 2020.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

21. Conditional Agreement for Removal of Offer of Dedication (Irrevocable)

  City Attorney Bill Curley gave the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Kelley, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to
  approve the agreement with Saddleback Valley Community Church.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

22.  Appointment to Fill One Unscheduled Vacancy on the Investment Advisory
  Commission

  Motion made by Council Member Sachs, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to
  appoint Brent Cranmer to the Investment Advisory Commission.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

23. Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Received the report from Council Member Kelley.

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

24. Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  By consensus, the City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars
  as presented in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public
  record.

City Council Minutes  6  December 10, 2019
 Council Member Bucknum

Council Member Bucknum announced that she attended the Santa’s Arrival celebration and
enjoyed the entertainment. She gave kudos to the Mission Viejo Activities Committee and City
staff for setting up the event. Council Member Bucknum announced that there are no Southern
California Association of Governments (SCAG) or Local Agency Formation Commission
(LAFCO) meetings in December and no SCAG meeting in January. She discussed her attendance
at the Mission Hospital Gala which raised $3 million dollars towards the expansion of the
emergency room and she stated that it was a great event. In closing, Council Member Bucknum
thanked the Mayor for his year of service and the wonderful State of the City video.

Council Member Kelley

Council Member Kelley thanked Mission Viejo Calvary Chapel for hosting a Friendsgiving Lunch
with Council Members, Police Services, and Fire Fighters in appreciation for all that they do. She
announced that she attended a few ribbon cutting ceremonies and Santa’s Arrival and she thanked
Pam Smith and Cathy Allen for the great event. She also announced that if residents missed Santa’s
Arrival, they still have the opportunity to see Santa in his workshop on Wednesdays, Saturdays
and Sundays from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. until Christmas. Council Member Kelley congratulated
Mayor Raths on a terrific year and a fantastic job as Mayor.

Council Member Sachs

Council Member Sachs congratulated Mayor Raths on a successful year and he observed that the
State of the City video honored everyone in the City. Council Member Sachs wished everyone a
Merry Christmas, Happy Hanukah and Happy New Year and stated that he looks forward to the
year ahead.

Mayor Pro Tem Goodell

Mayor Pro Tem Goodell announced that he too attended the Christmas lighting ceremony with his
wife and granddaughter and he thanked the Mission Viejo Activities Committee for a wonderful
event. He noted that he has spent some time with the City Manager and Assistant City Manager
regarding the Casta Del Sol Golf Course and the feedback he has heard regarding the City’s
purchase of the golf course has been very positive. Mayor Pro Tem Goodell said residents are very
excited to see what the City can do with the space. In conclusion, he congratulated Mayor Raths
for his service this past year and stated that he looks forward to the near future.

Mayor Raths

Mayor Raths announced that a homeless Veteran, Vern, is now housed in a nice apartment in
Garden Grove and he is very happy. He thanked Deputy Chaney and Mercy House for their efforts
in finding Vern a place to live. Mayor Raths asked that Police Services patrol the neighborhood
that the resident spoke about early in the meeting. Lastly, he stated that he attended the Heritage
Pointe 30-year Anniversary Gala and had a great time.

City Council Minutes  7  December 10, 2019
 CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

25. Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem for 2020

  Motion made by Mayor Raths, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to appoint Brian
  Goodell as Mayor for 2020.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Goodell, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to
  appoint Trish Kelley, as Mayor Pro Tem for 2020.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Raths, and Sachs
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 9:05 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Raths adjourned the meeting to Tuesday, January 14, 2020, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________
Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of January 14, 2020

City Council Minutes  8  December 10, 2019
